LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_SCHOOL_COMPARISON.zh_CN: 你读书那会儿的办法，现在还能照搬吗？

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_FIRST_JOB_CONTEXT.en: We got jobs straight after graduation. You study for years and still act picky.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_FIRST_JOB_COMPARISON.en: Were job requirements when you graduated the same as today?

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_OVERTIME_CONTEXT.zh_CN: 我们年轻时加班从不抱怨，就你们现在事多。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_OVERTIME_COMPARISON.en: Were your hours and pay back then the same as ours now?

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_RENT_CONTEXT.en: We bought homes after a few years of work. If you can't, you're not trying hard enough.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_RENT_COMPARISON.source: 你当年的工资和房价，跟现在是一回事吗？
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_RENT_COMPARISON.zh_CN: 你当年的工资和房价，跟现在是一回事吗？
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_RENT_COMPARISON.en: Were wages and house prices back then anything like today's?

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_NEIGHBORHOOD_COMPARIS.zh_CN: 以前的社区和现在住的人一样吗？
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_NEIGHBORHOOD_COMPARIS.en: Is this neighborhood, and who lives here, the same as it used to be?

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING.zh_CN: 说话人把轻松取得的好成绩说成遗憾，用假谦虚炫耀自己。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING.en: The speaker presents an easily earned good result as a disappointment, boasting through false modesty.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING_QUESTION.zh_CN: 反问是在等别人夸奖，又把求夸藏在“不值得夸”后面。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING_COMPARISON.source: 把别人的努力和自己的轻松并排，更显得自己不用费劲就能赢。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING_COMPARISON.zh_CN: 把别人的努力和自己的轻松并排，更显得自己不用费劲就能赢。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING_COMPARISON.en: Contrasting other people's effort with the speaker's ease makes success look effortless.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_MEANING_EXPLANATION.zh_CN: 补出的差距很小，进一步显出这份遗憾其实是在展示优势。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_MEANING.zh_CN: 没人提出要求，说话人却主动展开一大段，用这个反差自嘲过度热情。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_MEANING_EXPLANATION.zh_CN: 说出自己为什么停不下来，让这份主动显得具体可笑。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_EQUALITY_STRO.source: 这次尤其不认同凭成绩把人分出高低。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_EQUALITY_STRO.zh_CN: 这次尤其不认同凭成绩把人分出高低。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_EQUALITY_STRO.en: This use particularly rejects ranking people's worth by their scores.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_HIERARCHY.source: 这次更看重成绩带来的胜人一筹。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_HIERARCHY.zh_CN: 这次更看重成绩带来的胜人一筹。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_HIERARCHY.en: This use places more weight on being ahead of others.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_HIERARCHY_STR.source: 这次把领先别人的成绩看得格外重。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_HIERARCHY_STR.zh_CN: 这次把领先别人的成绩看得格外重。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_HIERARCHY_STR.en: This use places particular importance on outperforming others.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SINCERE.source: 这次较认真地对待自己没达到第一名的遗憾。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SINCERE.zh_CN: 这次较认真地对待自己没达到第一名的遗憾。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SINCERE.en: This use takes the disappointment at missing first place more seriously.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SINCERE_STRON.source: 这次的遗憾更接近真实的自我要求，炫耀仍藏在好成绩里。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SINCERE_STRON.zh_CN: 这次的遗憾更接近真实的自我要求，炫耀仍藏在好成绩里。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SINCERE_STRON.en: The disappointment is closer to a sincere personal standard, with the boast still carried by the good score.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_IRONIC.source: 嘴上失望、心里得意的反差更明显了。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_IRONIC.zh_CN: 嘴上失望、心里得意的反差更明显了。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_IRONIC.en: The gap between spoken disappointment and private pride is more apparent.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_IRONIC_STRONG.source: 这次尤其突出失望口气背后的得意。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_IRONIC_STRONG.zh_CN: 这次尤其突出失望口气背后的得意。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_IRONIC_STRONG.en: This use particularly emphasizes the pride beneath the disappointed tone.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SUPPORT.source: 这次更像和熟人分享得意，接受这种假谦虚。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SUPPORT.zh_CN: 这次更像和熟人分享得意，接受这种假谦虚。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SUPPORT.en: This use is more accepting of the humblebrag, as if sharing pride with friends.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SUPPORT_STRON.source: 这次明显纵容这种用假谦虚分享得意的说法。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SUPPORT_STRON.zh_CN: 这次明显纵容这种用假谦虚分享得意的说法。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_SUPPORT_STRON.en: This use clearly indulges false modesty as a way to share pride.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_OPPOSITION.source: 这次更像拿假谦虚的说话人开涮。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_OPPOSITION.zh_CN: 这次更像拿假谦虚的说话人开涮。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_OPPOSITION.en: This use is more at the expense of the person pretending to be modest.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_OPPOSITION_ST.source: 这次明显在嘲笑成绩很好还装作失望的人。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_OPPOSITION_ST.zh_CN: 这次明显在嘲笑成绩很好还装作失望的人。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_V_READING_OPPOSITION_ST.en: This use clearly mocks someone with an excellent result who pretends to be disappointed.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_FREEDOM.source: 这次更容许一个人没人问也想说两句。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_FREEDOM.zh_CN: 这次更容许一个人没人问也想说两句。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_FREEDOM.en: This use is more accepting of speaking even when nobody asks.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_FREEDOM_STRON.source: 这次尤其维护主动开口、不必等别人点名的自由。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_FREEDOM_STRON.zh_CN: 这次尤其维护主动开口、不必等别人点名的自由。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_FREEDOM_STRON.en: This use particularly defends the freedom to speak without waiting to be invited.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_AUTHORITY.source: 这次更在意开口前是否轮到自己。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_AUTHORITY_STR.zh_CN: 这次尤其强调先等别人邀请，再开始长篇解释。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_EQUALITY.source: 这次更希望大家都能分到说话的机会。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_EQUALITY.zh_CN: 这次更希望大家都能分到说话的机会。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_EQUALITY.en: This use places more weight on everyone having a chance to speak.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_HIERARCHY.source: 这次更容许懂得多的人主动多讲一点。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_HIERARCHY.zh_CN: 这次更容许懂得多的人主动多讲一点。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_HIERARCHY.en: This use is more accepting of knowledgeable people volunteering more detail.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_HIERARCHY_STR.source: 这次尤其认可熟悉话题的人多占一点发言空间。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_HIERARCHY_STR.zh_CN: 这次尤其认可熟悉话题的人多占一点发言空间。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_HIERARCHY_STR.en: This use particularly accepts people familiar with the topic taking more room to speak.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_SINCERE.source: 这次更认真地承认自己确实很想分享。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_SINCERE.zh_CN: 这次更认真地承认自己确实很想分享。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_SINCERE.en: This use more sincerely admits the wish to share.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_SINCERE_STRON.zh_CN: 这次的主动更接近真心热爱，自嘲只是轻轻带过。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_SINCERE_STRON.en: The enthusiasm is closer to sincere affection, with only a light touch of self-mockery.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_IRONIC.source: 这次更拿自己停不下来的样子开玩笑。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_IRONIC.zh_CN: 这次更拿自己停不下来的样子开玩笑。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_OPPOSITION_ST.source: 这次明显在讥讽没人问还要讲个不停的人。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_OPPOSITION_ST.zh_CN: 这次明显在讥讽没人问还要讲个不停的人。
LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_N_READING_OPPOSITION_ST.en: This use clearly mocks someone who keeps talking despite nobody asking.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_READING_FREEDOM.source: 这次更强调年轻人有权决定听不听。

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_READING_FREEDOM.en: This use puts more weight on younger people's right to decide whether to listen.

LOC_TEXT_COMPOSE_B_READING_AUTHORITY.zh_CN: 这次仍较愿意承认长辈有经验，只拒绝眼前的说教。
